goal: Triage findings exported from NucleusSec (Nucleus Security): prioritise, deduplicate, assign owners and track…
use: Triage findings exported from NucleusSec (Nucleus Security): prioritise, deduplicate, assign owners and track fixes. Use when a Nucleus export or a set of scanner findings needs a decision.

steps.note: Read the export. Use the findings file the user provides from Nucleus Security, or from the scanners connected to it.
Deduplicate. Group findings that describe the same flaw in the same component, even when different scanners report them.
Check exposure and severity. Use the severity, asset criticality and whether the asset is internet-facing to set priority.
Check ownership. Each finding needs an owner, normally the team that owns the component.
Check the fix path. Note whether a fix, a configuration change or a risk acceptance is the right response, and who must approve an acceptance.
Check ageing. Flag high-priority findings past their target date.

protocol.title: Read the export
protocol.text: Use the findings file the user provides from Nucleus Security, or from the scanners connected to it. Do not connect to the platform without the user's own access.

protocol.title: Deduplicate
protocol.text: Group findings that describe the same flaw in the same component, even when different scanners report them.

protocol.title: Check exposure and severity
protocol.text: Use the severity, asset criticality and whether the asset is internet-facing to set priority.

protocol.title: Check ownership
protocol.text: Each finding needs an owner, normally the team that owns the component. Flag findings with no owner.

protocol.title: Check the fix path
protocol.text: Note whether a fix, a configuration change or a risk acceptance is the right response, and who must approve an acceptance.

protocol.title: Check ageing
protocol.text: Flag high-priority findings past their target date.

protocol.title: Report
protocol.text: A ranked table: priority, finding, asset, owner, fix path, due date. Say that the ranking is advice for the owner to review. Mark what you could not verify.
